answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 24763 Country: United Kingdom Title: I will soon be starting an Accounting and Finance course. I had planned to do audit when I finish. In this country most companies deal with interest. Is it permissible to do audit for such companies. Question: AOA I will soon be starting an Accounting and Finance course. I had planned to do audit when I finish. In this country most companies deal with interest. Is it permissible to do audit for such companies. Answer ID: 24763 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1355/L=402/tl=1431) If you audit interest based calculations and do not write it directly then you can audit for the companies that deal in interest business. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
